messages:
ryan: noticed p99 spike for embeddings eu-west1 after yesterday's quant push. small customer-facing latency for long requests.
nana: can you drop the telemetry link?
ryan: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-west1 spike at 03:12 UTC correlating with image embed:v2.3.4-quant
product_ops: we need an expedited mitigation: plan, owner, rollback, changelog. ops + oncall please ack.
sre_oncall: ack. will approve staged canary if rollback is ready and owner is named.
ryan: proposal: pin back to embed:v2.2.10 in eu-west1 only, batch window -> 20ms. rollout 1% -> 10% -> 100% manual gates. owner = ana.
nana: I can run it. infra check?
product_ops: infra cleared for canary slices. I'll draft release note and tag expedited.
ryan: draft note:
```
Hotfix (expedited): revert embeddings image in eu-west1 from v2.3.4-quant to v2.2.10 and reduce batching window to 20ms to address elevated p99 latency on long-sequence requests.
```
deploybot: @ana scheduled deploy id=dr-1769007777-b. strategy=staged-canary [1%,10%,100%]. checks=[health,p95,p99,5xx]. manual approval required between stages.
sre_oncall: abort conditions: 5xx > 0.5% or p99 regresses > 20% sustained 5m.
nana: starting 1% canary now (dr-1769007777-b). watching p50/p95/p99 and error rate.
nana: 6m update: p95 -12%, p99 -20%, 5xx unchanged. approving 10%.
deploybot: progressing to 10% slice.
ryan: notifying impacted customers via status page (no downtime expected).
sre_oncall: 10% stable at 8m; proceed to 100%.
deploybot: deploy complete dr-1769007777-b -> 100% success.
product_ops: changelog entry posted and hotfix tagged expedited-critical.
nana: rollback one-liner:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embeddings --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.4-quant && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeddings -n prod
```
ryan: will follow up with RCA ticket and regression test for long-seq quantized paths. closing thread when RCA linked. :thumbsup:
